name: Anxious ~Yuukyuu no Memory~
source:
Near future. Technology advances have allowed to create a perfect artificial lover indistinguishable from real women. Main character gets a job to test four such robots every day. He understands those are robots, but can't help having feelings for them.

[From [url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.com/2017/11/vn-of-month-december-1999.html]vndbreview[/url]]
translation:
不久的将来。技术进步已经可以创造出与真实女性没有区别的完美人造情人。主角得到了一份工作，每天测试四个这样的机器人。他知道那些是机器人，但情不自禁地对它们产生了感情。

[来自[url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.com/2017/11/vn-of-month-december-1999.html]vndbreview[/url]]
